interpretations: Count distinct project IDs in `scanqc` for each `archstat`, including NULL as a separate status; divide each count by the sum of all status counts and return statuses above the mean share.

Count QC records for each `archstat`, allowing a project with multiple QC records to contribute multiple times; divide each count by the total QC record count and return statuses above the mean share.

Count each project once per archival status it has in `scanqc`, allowing a project to contribute to multiple statuses; divide each status count by the sum of those counts and return statuses above the mean share.
Count every project in `projects`, assigning projects with no QC record to the missing-status group; divide each status count by the sum of all status counts and return statuses above the mean share.
Treat both NULL and empty `archstat` values as the missing-status group when counting projects; divide each count by the sum of all status counts and return statuses above the mean share.
Count each distinct project once per archival status in `scanqc`, and include projects with no QC record in the missing-status group.

queries:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT archstat,
         1.0 * project_count / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT archstat, share
FROM status_shares
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT archstat,
         qc_count,
         1.0 * qc_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanqc) AS share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT archstat, qc_count, share
FROM status_shares
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)

WITH project_statuses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT arcref, archstat
    FROM scanqc
    WHERE archstat IS NOT NULL
),
status_counts AS (
    SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS project_count
    FROM project_statuses
    GROUP BY archstat
),
status_shares AS (
    SELECT archstat,
           1.0 * project_count / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM status_counts
)
SELECT archstat, share
FROM status_shares
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(q.ctrlstate, 'Missing') AS status,
         COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count
  FROM projects AS p
  LEFT JOIN scanqc AS q ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY COALESCE(q.ctrlstate, 'Missing')
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT status,
         project_count,
         1.0 * project_count / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT status, project_count, share
FROM status_shares
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)

WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(archstat), ''), 'Missing') AS status,
         COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(archstat), ''), 'Missing')
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT status,
         1.0 * project_count / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT status, share
FROM status_shares
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)

SELECT COALESCE(q.archstat, 'Missing') AS archival_status,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count
FROM projects AS p
LEFT JOIN scanqc AS q ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
GROUP BY COALESCE(q.archstat, 'Missing')
